bibl.title: The Society for Immunotherapy of Cancer consensus statement on immunotherapy for the treatment of squamous cell carcinoma of the head and neck

person.p: the tag layer; a sentence written by the tagger about the paper, always anchored to a quotation but not itself a quotation

span.label: A CONSENSUS THAT PUBLISHES ITS OWN VOTE SHARES - nineteen experts grading evidence into levels, defining consensus as a number, and printing the percentage behind each recommendation including the ones that failed
span.quote: Literature was graded into three categories of evidence which were adapted from the National Comprehensive Cancer Network (NCCN) guidelines and required consensus among SITC Head and Neck Cancer Guidelines Subcommittee members. Consensus was defined as ≥75% agreement among subcommittee members.

span.label: how the newly approved checkpoint inhibitors should be used in recurrent or metastatic head and neck cancer - patient selection, sequence, response monitoring, adverse events and biomarker testing
span.quote: Due to country-specific variances in approvals, availability and regulations regarding the discussed agents, this panel focused solely on FDA-approved drugs for the treatment of patients in the U.S.

span.label: consensus recommendations with an evidence level attached to each, a summary table mixing two vote thresholds, and per-item vote percentages throughout the text
span.quote: A summary table providing high level consensus recommendations (those with level 1 and level 2A evidence) plus lower evidence, but has more than 50% subcommittee votes, is provided

span.label: method
span.quote: Literature was graded into three categories of evidence which were adapted from the National Comprehensive Cancer Network (NCCN) guidelines and required consensus among SITC Head and Neck Cancer Guidelines Subcommittee members. Consensus was defined as ≥75% agreement among subcommittee members.

span.label: clinical advice as a vocabulary whose items carry the proportion of experts behind them
span.quote: The majority of the subcommittee recommended routine monitoring of thyroid function (94%), neck and airway through imaging (62.5%), and AST/ALT levels (75%). Lipase evaluation was recommended by 44% of the subcommittee, while brain imaging was only recommended by 6% of members. The subcommittee was split on whether whole-body imaging is necessary during treatment.

span.label: expert subcommittee, MEDLINE search 2012-2018 reduced to 157 manuscripts, evidence graded on an NCCN-adapted scale, consensus defined as at least 75% agreement
span.term: expert subcommittee, MEDLINE search 2012-2018 reduced to 157 manuscripts, evidence graded on an NCCN-adapted scale, consensus defined as at least 75% agreement
span.quote: Literature was graded into three categories of evidence which were adapted from the National Comprehensive Cancer Network (NCCN) guidelines and required consensus among SITC Head and Neck Cancer Guidelines Subcommittee members. Consensus was defined as ≥75% agreement among subcommittee members.

span.label: CONSENSUS IS A NUMBER HERE, NOT A FEELING: `CONSENSUS WAS DEFINED AS >= 75% AGREEMENT among subcommittee members`, on a scale `ADAPTED FROM THE NATIONAL COMPREHENSIVE CANCER NETWORK (NCCN) GUIDELINES`
span.quote: Literature was graded into three categories of evidence which were adapted from the National Comprehensive Cancer Network (NCCN) guidelines and required consensus among SITC Head and Neck Cancer Guidelines Subcommittee members. Consensus was defined as ≥75% agreement among subcommittee members.

span.label: AND THE LEVELS CROSS EVIDENCE QUALITY WITH AGREEMENT, INCLUDING ONE WHOSE CONTENT IS THE DISAGREEMENT: `category 1 ... HIGH-LEVEL EVIDENCE WITH CONSENSUS; category 2A ... LOWER-LEVEL EVIDENCE WHERE THERE IS UNIFORM CONSENSUS; category 2B ... GENERAL CONSENSUS; and CATEGORY 3 IS BASED UPON ANY LEVEL OF EVIDENCE, EVEN WHERE THERE IS SUBSTANTIAL DISAGREEMENT that the intervention is appropriate. ALL RECOMMENDATIONS ARE CATEGORY 2A UNLESS OTHERWISE NOTED`
span.quote: In short, category 1 is based upon high-level evidence with consensus among the committee members that the intervention is appropriate; category 2A is based upon lower-level evidence where there is uniform consensus that the intervention is appropriate; category 2B is based upon lower-level evidence where there is general consensus that the intervention is appropriate; and category 3 is based upon any level of evidence, even where there is substantial disagreement that the intervention is appropriate. All recommendations are category 2A unless otherwise noted

span.label: AND THE VOTES THAT LOST ARE PRINTED BESIDE THE ONES THAT WON: `routine monitoring of THYROID FUNCTION (94%), NECK AND AIRWAY THROUGH IMAGING (62.5%), and AST/ALT LEVELS (75%). LIPASE evaluation was recommended by 44% ... while BRAIN IMAGING WAS ONLY RECOMMENDED BY 6% OF MEMBERS. The subcommittee WAS SPLIT on whether whole-body imaging is necessary`. A 6% recommendation in the same sentence as a 94% one
span.quote: The majority of the subcommittee recommended routine monitoring of thyroid function (94%), neck and airway through imaging (62.5%), and AST/ALT levels (75%). Lipase evaluation was recommended by 44% of the subcommittee, while brain imaging was only recommended by 6% of members. The subcommittee was split on whether whole-body imaging is necessary during treatment.

span.label: and a minority position is published as a minority: `A SUBSTANTIAL MINORITY of the subcommittee also agreed that significant burden and pace of disease requiring rapid tumor burden reduction (44%) and steroid dosing ... (38%) would be reasons NOT to give anti-PD-1 monotherapy`
span.quote: Moreover, a substantial minority of the subcommittee also agreed that significant burden and pace of disease requiring rapid tumor burden reduction (44%) and steroid dosing for any reason over 10 mg/day of prednisone or equivalent (38%) would be reasons not to give anti-PD-1 monotherapy to a platinum chemotherapy-refractory HNSCC patient.

span.label: AND THE SUMMARY TABLE MIXES TWO THRESHOLDS IN ONE COLUMN: `high level consensus recommendations (those with level 1 and level 2A evidence) PLUS LOWER EVIDENCE, BUT HAS MORE THAN 50% SUBCOMMITTEE VOTES`. The document's own consensus bar is 75%, and its summary table admits items at 50%
span.quote: A summary table providing high level consensus recommendations (those with level 1 and level 2A evidence) plus lower evidence, but has more than 50% subcommittee votes, is provided

span.label: THE PAPER SAYS THREE CATEGORIES AND LISTS FOUR: `Literature was graded into THREE CATEGORIES of evidence`, then `category 1 ... category 2A ... category 2B ... and category 3`. Verified by extracting the labels rather than by reading: four distinct labels. **SECOND INSTANCE OF THIS SHAPE IN THE CORPUS** - katayama2016 announces `FIVE GRADES of severity (Grade I, II, IIIa, IIIb, IVa, IVb, and V)`, seven labels for five grades. In both the ambiguity is between a CLASS AND ITS SUBDIVISIONS, and in both one word does duty for each
span.quote: In short, category 1 is based upon high-level evidence with consensus among the committee members that the intervention is appropriate; category 2A is based upon lower-level evidence where there is uniform consensus that the intervention is appropriate; category 2B is based upon lower-level evidence where there is general consensus that the intervention is appropriate; and category 3 is based upon any level of evidence, even where there is substantial disagreement that the intervention is appropriate. All recommendations are category 2A unless otherwise noted

span.label: ONE BIOMARKER, TWO SCORING SYSTEMS, DIFFERENT CUT POINTS BY JURISDICTION: the European approval requires `PD-L1 with a >= 50% TUMOR PROPORTION SCORE` while the later FDA approval uses `a PD-L1 COMBINED POSITIVE SCORE >= 1`. Same protein, different denominators - TPS counts tumour cells, CPS counts tumour and immune cells - and the regulators chose differently
span.quote: The European Commission followed in 2017 with approval of nivolumab for treatment of the same patient population, and shortly thereafter with approval of pembrolizumab monotherapy for the treatment of recurrent or metastatic HNSCC in adults whose tumors express PD-L1 with a ≥ 50% tumor proportion score and have progressed on or after platinum-containing chemotherapy. Then in 2019, the FDA granted approval for PD-1 inhibition as first-line treatment for patients with metastatic or unresectable, recurrent HNSCC, approving pembrolizumab in combination with platinum and fluorouracil for all patients with HNSCC and pembrolizumab as a single agent for patients with HNSCC whose tumors express a PD-L1 combined positive score ≥ 1.

span.label: and the test is licensed with the drug: `The FDA also EXPANDED THE INTENDED USE for the PD-L1 IHC 22C3 pharmDx kit to include use as A COMPANION DIAGNOSTIC for selecting patients`. The threshold, the antibody and the indication move together
span.quote: The FDA also expanded the intended use for the PD-L1 IHC 22C3 pharmDx kit to include use as a companion diagnostic for selecting patients with HNSCC for treatment with pembrolizumab as a single agent.

span.label: THE ADVERSE-EVENT COUNT DEPENDS ON THE REPORTING WINDOW: `some studies have only required safety assessment UP TO 30 DAYS AFTER THE LAST DOSE, WHEREAS other studies EXPLICITLY EXCLUDE reporting of adverse events that occur MORE THAN 30 DAYS after the last dose, OR AFTER STARTING ANOTHER CANCER TREATMENT`
span.quote: For instance, some studies have only required safety assessment up to 30 days after the last dose, whereas other studies explicitly exclude reporting of adverse events that occur more than 30 days after the last dose, or after starting another cancer treatment

span.label: and a class of events falls outside every window: `there is growing evidence to suggest the existence of POST-IMMUNOTHERAPY irAEs, WHICH OCCUR MONTHS OR YEARS AFTER TREATMENT DISCONTINUATION ... it will be necessary to RECOGNIZE THIS EMERGING CLINICAL ENTITY and PERHAPS ADJUST FOLLOW-UP AND REPORTING TIMES`
span.quote: Of note, while most irAEs appear to occur during immunotherapy [ 1 , 3 – 13 , 15 , 16 , 19 ], there is growing evidence to suggest the existence of post-immunotherapy irAEs, which occur months or years after treatment discontinuation [ 16 – 18 , 30 , 102 ]. With an increasing number of neoadjuvant/adjuvant IO trials currently being conducted in the definitive/curative setting, it will be necessary to recognize this emerging clinical entity and perhaps adjust follow-up and reporting times.

span.label: THE LABEL'S POPULATION IS WIDER THAN THE EVIDENCE'S, STATED PLAINLY: `Current FDA approvals ... HAVE NO ELIGIBILITY RESTRICTIONS ... patients reliant on steroids or with underlying immune dysfunction are ALSO TECHNICALLY ELIGIBLE to receive immunotherapy EVEN THOUGH THEY WERE NOT USUALLY INCLUDED IN PIVOTAL CLINICAL TRIALS`
span.quote: Current FDA approvals for nivolumab and pembrolizumab for the treatment of patients with R/M HNSCC have no eligibility restrictions [ 108 , 109 ]. For instance, these approvals suggest that patients with Epstein-Barr virus (EBV)-associated nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC) also qualify for immune checkpoint therapies [ 110 ]. Additionally, patients reliant on steroids or with underlying immune dysfunction are also technically eligible to receive immunotherapy even though they were not usually included in pivotal clinical trials.

span.label: and the guideline scopes itself out of the same gap: patients with organ dysfunctions, autoimmune conditions and other pre-existing conditions `WERE LARGELY NOT ENROLLED into the discussed trials and EXTRAPOLATION OF CLINICAL RECOMMENDATIONS TO THESE PATIENT POPULATIONS ARE OUTSIDE THE PURVIEW OF THIS GUIDELINE`
span.quote: Most of the referenced immunotherapy trials include patients with Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) Performance Status (PS) 0 or 1. Additionally, patients with organ dysfunctions, history of clinically significant autoimmune conditions, and other pre-existing conditions were largely not enrolled into the discussed trials and extrapolation of clinical recommendations to these patient populations are outside the purview of this guideline.

span.label: and the whole document is scoped to one jurisdiction on purpose: `Due to COUNTRY-SPECIFIC VARIANCES IN APPROVALS, availability and regulations ... this panel FOCUSED SOLELY ON FDA-APPROVED DRUGS for the treatment of patients in the U.S.`
span.quote: Due to country-specific variances in approvals, availability and regulations regarding the discussed agents, this panel focused solely on FDA-approved drugs for the treatment of patients in the U.S.
